Frequently Asked
Questions
Price & Legitimacy
Is Tirzepatide really $149.99 a month?
Yes. Tirzepatide is $149.99 per month. Semaglutide is $99.99 per month. No hidden fees or dose-based price increases.
Is this legitimate?
Yes. A Better Lou is LegitScript certified, with licensed medical providers, real pharmacy fulfillment, and real human support, all based in the USA.
Why is the price so low?
We built A Better Lou to be faster, easier and more affordable than the competition. Fewer unnecessary steps mean straightforward pricing and less runaround.
What exactly does $149.99 include for Tirzepatide?
Your prescribed medication, provider care, injection supplies, overnight shipping, and real human support from A Better Lou are all included.
Will my price go up if my dose goes up?
No. Your monthly GLP-1 price does not increase based on your prescribed dose.
Speed & Approval
What if the provider doesn’t approve me?
You get a full refund, no strings attached. You’re only prescribed treatment if a licensed provider determines it’s appropriate for you.
Do I pay before talking to a medical provider?
You can talk to a licensed medical provider before paying by calling us or using live chat. Or you can purchase now to get started faster, and we’ll call you to go over a brief medical questionnaire. If you’re not approved, you get a full refund with no strings attached.
Can I talk to someone before I buy?
Yes. Call or live chat with a licensed medical provider before checkout to ask any questions you have about GLP-1 treatment.
How fast can I get started?
A Better Lou is faster than the competition. We’ll call you within hours to confirm your health information. You’ll talk to a licensed medical provider the same day. Once prescribed, medication ships overnight from the pharmacy.
Do I need to visit a doctor’s office?
No. Our GLP-1 process is handled remotely through telehealth, from the comfort of your home.
Support & Medication
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Your GLP-1 subscription is month-to-month, and you can cancel anytime.
Where does the medication come from?
Once prescribed, your medication is filled and shipped overnight by our U.S.-based pharmacy partner.
Is the treatment the same for everyone?
No. A licensed provider reviews your health information and determines what treatment and dosage are appropriate for you.
Can I reach a real person at anytime?
Yes. You can reach the A Better Lou team by phone, text, live chat, or email. You can also speak with a licensed medical provider before purchasing to ask any questions about GLP-1 treatment.
Is A Better Lou GLP-1 treatment available in my state?
Availability depends on your state. Enter your state during checkout to confirm whether A Better Lou currently serves your area.
